title: Return policy
text: Aurora Store accepts unused standard products within 30 calendar days of delivery. Custom-made products are excluded. The buyer must provide the order ID. Shipping time does not reduce the return window.

title: Warranty policy
text: Aurora Store provides a two-year warranty for manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and normal wear are excluded. A warranty claim requires the order ID and a description of the defect. Warranty coverage is separate from the 30-day return policy.

title: Domestic shipping
text: Standard domestic delivery takes three to five business days after dispatch. This estimate excludes dispatch processing and public holidays. International delivery has no fixed published timeline in this handbook.

title: Dispatch cutoff
text: Orders confirmed before 14:00 UTC on a business day are dispatched that day. Orders confirmed after the cutoff are dispatched on the next business day. Weekend orders join the next business-day queue.

title: Aurora Basic
text: The Aurora Basic subscription includes 10 GB of project storage and 30 days of operational logs. Basic does not include priority support. Storage refers to project files, not backup archives.

title: Aurora Pro
text: The Aurora Pro subscription includes 100 GB of project storage and 90 days of operational logs. Pro includes priority support. The monthly price is not documented in this handbook.

title: Authentication lifecycle
text: Access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Service-account client secrets must be rotated every 90 days. Expired access tokens are renewed with the configured refresh mechanism; rotating a client secret is a separate maintenance operation.

title: Export downloads
text: Generated export download links expire seven days after creation. Expiry disables the download link; it is separate from archive-deletion policy. Sensitive exports must never be attached to public issue reports.

title: Vega invoices
text: Vega accounts are billed in EUR with net-30 payment terms. These terms apply to the Vega contract only. Atlas accounts use a different billing schedule.

title: Atlas invoices
text: Atlas accounts are billed in USD with net-15 payment terms. These terms apply to the Atlas contract only. Vega accounts use a different currency and payment deadline.

title: Severity 1 incidents
text: A Severity 1 incident requires acknowledgment within 15 minutes and status updates every 30 minutes. The incident commander coordinates the response. These are response targets, not a guarantee of resolution time.

title: Severity 2 incidents
text: A Severity 2 incident requires acknowledgment within four hours and status updates every 24 hours. Resolution time depends on the cause and is not fixed by this policy.

title: Graph indexing
text: Graph extraction uses rules by default. Unchanged text can reuse content-addressed extraction cache entries. New document chunks are indexed incrementally. A full rebuild is reserved for recovery or extraction-profile changes.

title: Archive deletion
text: A requested archive deletion has a 30-day cooling-off period before final removal. Authorized owners can cancel it during the cooling-off period. Export download-link expiry does not itself trigger archive deletion.

title: Orion ownership
text: The Orion platform is owned by Team Lumen. Orion handles internal workflow scheduling. Ownership identifies the team responsible for approvals and operations, rather than the team using the platform.

title: Team Lumen operations
text: Team Lumen's on-call owner approves high-risk operational changes for platforms owned by Lumen. Requests are filed through OpsDesk. A model-generated proposal is not approval evidence.

title: Aster storage
text: The Aster job service persists execution records in the Polaris database. Aster does not manage a separate backup schedule; the database's backup policy applies.

title: Polaris backups
text: Polaris database backups run daily at 02:00 UTC and are retained for 30 days. Restores require an authorized operator. The backup policy does not specify a guaranteed restore duration.

title: Nimbus stewardship
text: Team Helix is the steward of the Nimbus dataset. Nimbus contains internal operational records. Export permissions follow the steward team's governance process.

title: Team Helix exports
text: Exporting private datasets stewarded by Team Helix requires approval from the data-governance group. Steward membership alone does not authorize export. Public sample fixtures use a separate review process.

title: Courier damage claims
text: A courier damage claim must be submitted within 48 hours of delivery with photographs of the package and damage. Do not include account passwords, access tokens, or unrelated personal information.

title: Return evidence
text: A return request needs the order ID. For a damaged product, include a photograph showing the defect. Do not submit account credentials. Standard unused-product eligibility follows the return policy.

title: EU workspace residency
text: Files for EU-region workspaces are stored in Frankfurt. Workspace region controls file residency. This document makes no claim about every external model provider's processing location.

title: Diagnostic records
text: Diagnostic records are retained for 30 days. Operators should redact sensitive content before sharing diagnostic excerpts. Project operational-log retention is plan-specific and is described in the subscription policies.
